description: Her mind in a group chat as one deterministic machine in the shared core (myriad_merope::group, behind the C ABI as group.*). Whichever end hosts her runs it; the end only does what it says and comes back with what happened. One step at a time per group: the end keeps each group's state as handed back and gives it to the next step of that group. Nothing in the core reads a clock, rolls dice, waits or touches a store.

conventions.time: Microseconds since the Unix epoch (i64), except a kept line's at, which is RFC 3339 as the line has always been stored.
conventions.chance: seed (u64) per step; rolls (numbers in [0,1)) are used first when given, then a fixed SplitMix64 from the seed.
conventions.names: camelCase, except the stored shapes (line, ledger), which keep the field names they have always been stored with.
conventions.her: her is how she is as the step happens: away (not on this end, D3: she is not in the group either), asleepFor (seconds until she wakes), busyFor (seconds until she is free of something of her own), today (her date in her zone, YYYY-MM-DD).
conventions.venue: A group is <platform>:<chat id>; platform is the slug (telegram, discord, onebot).

input: state (null for a group she has nothing in mind of)
group.step.description: One step. A state of another stateVersion is read as nothing in mind.

group.offer.description: The group as she weighs saying something first in it: null when she is busy, talking or muted there, has no line there to say it by, or it has gone more than three days unseen. The end also leaves out a group it cannot send to.

input: stored (the ledger as kept, or null)
group.merge_ledger.description: What a ledger effect adds to the group's ledger, keeping the latest 2000 messages and 500 waits. The end keeps it 30 days.

group.ledger_who.description: A member as the ledger knows them: the first six bytes of SHA-256 of their platform id, in hex.

group.kept_as_heard.description: Kept lines as the group's talk read back, for resumed after a restart on a platform that cannot read a group back.

restored.description: What was kept of the group before a restart, once: the end reads it the first time it touches a group (lines null when nothing was kept).

reached.description: A group she is in, as kept before a restart: where she would say something first, and when she last saw a line there.

heard.description: Any line in the group. fresh says whether it was new; a line handed in again is not heard twice. restore carries what was kept before a restart the first time after one.

called.description: A line that calls her. The end is told settled{waiter} when she is done with it, or at once when she will only see it a long while on.

noticed.description: A line that does not call her by name.

muted.description: She was muted there, or it lifted; mute is for{seconds}, untilLifted or lifted.

resumed.description: restart: the group read back after this end restarted (upSince is when it first heard a group); the line that called her before it and that she never got to is taken up. back: she is on this end again; the latest line that called her while away is taken up, if within six hours.

speakFirst.description: Say something first there for reason, billed to owner; settled{waiter, value: whether she said it}.

done.description: The answer to an effect with an id.

stickerSent.description: A sticker effect went out. restore as for heard, when what was kept before a restart has not been read yet.

keepReach.description: Keep that she is in the group (three days): thread and seenAt.

jargon.description: A line someone else said, for the words she watches there.

takeIn.description: A stretch of the talk, for what she heard in it and what the group was like, on the site owner's account.

pictureAgain.description: A picture sent there again: the group's.

spokeUp.description: Her speaking up there, and whether anyone took it up within five minutes.

strangerAfter.description: After she answered someone from outside: count the exchange, and let her note on them catch up.

sticker.description: Send the sticker she chose to `to`, making it first when new.

settled.description: Tell waiter she is done with what it handed in.

look.description: Look at pictures, on the site owner's account; a sticker she would send is kept.

identify.description: Who wrote the line: member{userId, bound}, stranger or unknown; and the site's owner.

prepare.description: Whether userId may talk to her now, with their session in this group ready.

read.answer: soul{text} | rows{rows} | life{did, would_tell, now} | now{local, doing} | stickers{stickers, can_make, left} | titles{titles} | label{label} | cues{cues} | vectors{vectors, known} | unread
read.description: Read something kept (unread: ownRows or life could not be read, the store is down; what needs it is left); of is hers (her host) or others (the site, H4-g2). what: soul; venueRows{venue, source, newest: updated|created, limit} (memories still standing, newest first, each {id, content, concepts, source, evidence, venue, createdAt, accessCount, lastAccessedAt}); ownRows{source: view|heard|meme, limit} (hers, the same rows); unowned{venue, source: stranger|maybe_is, marker} and unownedElsewhere{here, source, marker, limit} (others: rows with no owner whose evidence carries marker, in venue or in groups other than here); otherGroups{here, sources: bit|group_day|jargon, limit} (others: rows kept in groups other than here, empty here for any group); titles{venues} (others: what each group calls itself, [[venue, name|null]]); label{user_id} (others: how someone from the community goes by); now (hers: her clock in her zone, RFC 3339, and what she is doing); stickers{venue} (hers: the stickers she may send there, most sent first, each {id, meaning, venue, sent, lastSentAt, keptFrom}, with can_make and left this month); life{talk, related} (hers: her host's life as facts, D2b-2 = C: did [[what, what stayed]] that the talk touches, at most related; would_tell, what of her own time she would tell someone; now, what she is doing now, or null); cues{ids}; vectors{rows: [[id, text]], fill} (vectors kept under the model in use, giving up to fill of the rest one behind the reply; known false when there is no model or they could not be read). What comes to mind of what is read is worked out in the core (myriad_agent_rules::memory::rank).

embed.description: The vector of text, as the embedding model in use gives it; none when there is none or it did not answer in time.

write.description: Keep something; of as for read. what: rememberInVenue{venue, content, evidence, source} (others); rememberOwn{content, evidence, concepts, source: meme} (hers: a word she learned); watch{venue, term, used} (others: a word she could not learn, watched as maybe the group's own).

mayLookUp.description: Whether she may look term up now: tried already today (left), nothing left of the day's allowance for words and memes (watched), or yes. Hers; a host without the allowance only answers tried or yes.

define.description: What the slang and meme dictionaries have for term.

search.description: A search for query, with what its first result says.

readLedger.description: The piece counts the group's ledger kept.

readKept.description: What was kept of the group before a restart, read again because it could not be read when the line came: asked before her own line is kept (her reply, her reaction), so it is kept under what was kept and does not overwrite it.

turn.description: A member's turn in their account: what she says (still the end's, coarse in D2a).

soupTurn.description: The group's turtle soup at this turn (the end's until D2c): words from asker judged when a game is on, billed to owner; none when no game is on.

soupStart.description: She said she would think one up: the puzzle she brings out.

soupAfter.description: After her reply: a game this turn ended is over, and the group remembers it.

ask.description: Ask the model: how (json: a JSON answer to schema with system; say: what she says to the whole prompt in input; look), voice (judge, hers, hersAtLength), owner billed, operation, timeout_ms, system, input, schema_name, schema. failure is unavailable, timeout, cut, invalid or failed; whether to ask again is the core's.

send.description: Send one message of hers to `to`: pieces (text, or mention{id, name}), quoting the line it answers when quote.

end: Keep each group's state as handed back; step one group one event at a time.
Do the effects of a step in order. Those with an id are answered with done{id, answer} when they are done; the rest are done and not answered.

Before the first heard or muted of a group after a restart, read what was kept and hand it in as restore (and with stickerSent while it is still not read); for other events, step restored first. When it cannot be read, hand in none: the core asks again with readKept before her own line is kept.
Secrets (bot tokens) stay with the end: no event or effect carries one.
fixtures: crates/myriad-merope/fixtures/group/*.json: {steps: [{input, output}], state}. Replay: state starts null; each step's input gets the state the step before handed back; output must equal, and the state at the end must equal state.
